drafts.draft_en:
2D to 3D in one pass 👀

I took a flat AI VFX frame and turned it into a full 3D camera move. Same lighting, same character, zero modeling.

Workflow below, steal it.
drafts.video_tip: 8-10s: open on the flat 2D frame for 1s, then the camera pushes into it and orbits as it becomes 3D. No text overlay except 'flat → 3D' at the start. Workflow and prompt in reply 1.

drafts.draft_en:
I tested AI video-to-3D on the hardest shot I have: smoke, glass and a fast camera.

Here is where it holds up and where it breaks.
drafts.video_tip: 12-15s split screen: source VFX shot left, 3D reconstruction right, slow orbit. Freeze on the frame where it breaks and circle the artifact. Honest verdict in the caption keeps the replies coming.

drafts.draft_en:
One face. Six materials. Zero cuts.

Glass, chrome, wood, paper, smoke, stone, all in one AI transformation shot.

Full prompt below 👇
drafts.video_tip: 10s continuous morph, one material every ~1.5s, locked camera so the transformation does the work. Open mid-transformation on glass, not on the plain face. Prompt in reply 1.

drafts.draft_en:
Prompt share: cinematic AI VFX hero shot

A cinematic full-body render of [character], [armor] forged from [material], volumetric backlight, slow dolly-in, 35mm, film grain.

Swap the brackets and post yours 👇
drafts.video_tip: Image carousel of 4 variations from the same template, then a 6s animated version of the best one as the last slide. Invite people to reply with their version, it ties into the Saturday Challenge.

drafts.draft_en:
This shot would have taken a VFX team weeks on House of David.

Today it took me one afternoon with AI.

Here is the before and after.
drafts.video_tip: 8s before/after wipe: raw plate, then the finished AI VFX shot, with a single slow wipe across the frame. No music hit until the reveal. Keep any production details you're allowed to share in reply 1.
